structure.unit: Virginia Residential Landlord and Tenant Act

law.catch_line: Tenancy at will; effect of notice of change of terms or provisions of tenancy
law.text: A notice of any change by a landlord or tenant in any terms or provisions of a tenancy at will shall constitute a notice to vacate the premises, and such notice of change shall be given in accordance with the terms of the rental agreement, if any, or as otherwise required by law.
